en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 11. Ḥukaym ibn Dāwūd ibn Ḥukaym narrated to me from Salamah ibn Khaťťāb, from ‘Ali ibn Sayf, from Faďl ibn Mālik Al-Nakha’i, from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Yaḥyā Al-Madani, from Safwān ibn Sulaym, from his father, who said: The Prophet (s.a.a.w.) said:
Those who come to my Ziyārah during my life or after my death will be my neighbours on the Day of Judgment.
